items.title: The Gabriel-Popescu adjunction is an equivalence on the module side
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived functor arising from the Gabriel-Popescu adjunction is fully faithful (statement lines 2921-2937). The proof is a complete argument: the derived functor is computed on K-injective representatives (proof lines 2939-2948); on such a representative the composite of the two functors is the identity because the functors are inverse to each other on the module side (proof lines 2949-2951); and the criterion for full faithfulness of an adjunction then gives the conclusion (proof lines 2952-2953). The non-formal content is the computation of the composite on representatives. The claim is H2.
